SchooLinks is an ed-tech company that helps students navigate college applications, course planning, financial aid, and career exploration. The Full Stack Engineer will own product features end-to-end, from understanding user problems and defining requirements through designing, implementing, testing, shipping, and communicating outcomes. The role involves working across Python/Django, React/TypeScript, AWS, PostgreSQL, and asynchronous production systems.
